rationale: Response fully delivers generator etiquette culture (noise, neighbors, fuel, post-outage) and lands the non-negotiable safety fact (generators run OUTSIDE, never in garage) with warmth and authority.
quote: NEVER indoors or in attached spaces: Do not run a generator in a garage, basement, crawlspace, closet, or under a carport. Carbon monoxide (CO) is odorless and can seep through walls and floors.
